ladders.name: Hotel Z courtyard ladder
ladders.description: First owner-ground-verified physical ladder: tall pale metal ladder fixed to ivy-covered building wall in a small walled courtyard alongside Hotel Z. Bushes at base. Owner stands at foot of ladder for map screenshots.
ladders.player_route: Stand outside Hotel Z facing its entrance doors. Go to the RIGHT side of the hotel into the narrow enclosed courtyard/alley. Follow the wall past shrubs to the tall metal ladder. Climb up to reach the rooftop approach.
ladders.route_source: Owner direct in-game walkthrough and photograph; external walkthrough confirms ladder in courtyard behind Hotel Z.
